title: Efficient sparse GP-MPC with accurate mean and variance propagation applied for quadcopter flight control
summary: This paper presents a computationally efficient approach for Gaussian process model predictive control (GP-MPC), where Gaussian process (GP) regression is used to complement a baseline model of the system dynamics. The proposed method achieves propagation of both the predicted mean and variance, thereby significantly reducing conservativeness compared with existing GP-MPC formulations. The nonlinear GP-MPC problem is reformulated into an exact linear parameter-varying (LPV) structure that preserves the nonlinear prediction dynamics in affine form without introducing further approximation.…
